name: ARDENNE Teala: Convertible
description:
Grab those bag, for the Ardenne Teala has arrived. A sophisticated open top grand tourer from ARDENNE, combining elegant proportions, modern styling, and the freedom of a convertible. Comes with 8 color variations.

The Teala is designed for those who want luxury without sacrificing personality. Its flowing bodywork, low-profile stance, sculpted front end, and spacious four-seat interior give it a distinctive road presence. The Teala brings a more relaxed and expressive character to the Ardenne lineup. Built for speed and the wind
